how: The proposer calls for helpers because drawing the fox alone would take too long.
A member proposes the fox and later recalls an earlier solitary attempt eclipsed by another group.
A bare yes accepts the invitation without asking for anything in return.
Builders explicitly report too few hands and a canvas judged effectively full.
Questions about where to build and which design to follow receive coordinates and confirmation.
A participant attributes entering the canvas effort to the proposed picture's adorableness.
A self-described voider attributes staying to help to the fox's cuteness rather than a prior alliance.
Reported friction in chat does not establish withdrawal under strain or repair of an internal quarrel.
Builders clarify the chosen image, discuss grass and propose adding the subreddit name.
A builder reports the orange dot already placed.
Coordinates and templates guide placement while public corrections direct stray pixels back to the design.
A script is offered, accepted alongside a manual preference and later distributed to defenders.
Script targets are limited to essential parts and cropped to respect neighbouring space.
An explicit temporary handover supplies a local instance of decided order within the population claim's minority allowance.
Leaving for sleep explicitly prompts handing charge to another builder.
A participant grounds grief over final loss in hours spent working on the fox.
Members create a coordination chat for helpers and bring a protection report back to the public thread.
Public template correction continues alongside the new chat, so adding a venue does not establish exclusive off-thread control.
A public chat invite and protection report do not establish secret planning, infiltration or spying.
The coded screenshot defence does not identify a platform fault or establish whether its pixels were globally synchronised.
Builders clean stray pixels during construction and rally when the fox falls apart.
The added planned-change mechanism cannot be established from accidental template errors and border instructions without evidence of uninformed keepers reversing an agreed revision.
Participants identify covering groups while attributing organised overwriting to scripts partly by inference.
Initial site-finding pairs requests for a location with coordinates and a separate offer of uncontested room.
Later site changes follow reported lost progress, so they cannot all be treated as occurring before any loss.
A participant reports relocating the fox to new coordinates.
A near-close move remains a proposal where subsequent testimony says the fox cannot be saved.
Builders seek permission and negotiate revised locations with neighbouring groups.
Neighbouring builders exchange assistance for vacated space and later receive acknowledgement of their help.
Permission to cross a neighbouring work is paired with reserving a corner for it.
Specific overlap permission supports only the demonstrated arrangement rather than lasting guest status or general host control.
A participant speaks to neighbouring moderators and returns with permission for the shared design.
Prior occupation is invoked to justify fighting, and a repairer explicitly describes stopping conversion as fair.
A repairer explicitly identifies the fox moderator as a fellow member of the covering group.
An incoming group stops converting the fox and helps repair the damage.
The repairer's stated explanation combines a polite appeal with overlapping membership.
After closure, recipients reject a covering group's apology and announced relocation as too late.
An offer of mutual defence receives alliance language and a commitment to defend both works.
A reported deal and later resistance do not explicitly state limits on representative authority or who may bind all placers.
Members create a project chat around the fox, supporting the candidate's minimal chat form without establishing an independent faction.
The identified overwriter is not connected in the concepts to a pre-canvas quarrel.
Defensive calls do not identify an inherited tie as the reason for an outgoing attack.
A proposed subreddit signature and affection for a fox do not establish carried-in lore, ideology or colour faith.
Naming Pixel and celebrating its survival in the header do not themselves establish a new joke taken up by the room.
Anger at destruction and rejection of an apology do not establish a dispute about offensive words or hate symbols.
The practical invitation gives no evidence of a host April Fools fake or takeover.
Moderator defence and header adoption do not establish a rule or debate containing canvas talk.
Blaming the fox's destruction does not establish a host member attacking its mark in opposition to canvas posts.
Participants thank helpers during organising and later credit the designer and value the shared effort despite loss.
The room announces closure, defends a fleeting screenshot and mourns work lost before the end.
Participants welcome a cleaned version for restoring their corner without demonstrating that they requested or edited it.
Screenshot authentication after a question and welcome for a cleanup do not establish correction of a false account or active contest over retained history.
The fox becomes the subreddit header and is greeted as still alive.
Helping a pictured fox or entering the canvas effort does not establish finding or joining the subreddit through its mark.
Crediting a design contributor does not establish seeking recognition from outside creators, organisations or the press.
An incoming repairer acknowledges conversion of the fox, establishing received attack rather than an outgoing raid by the focal room.
After loss, a participant blames bots while replies to an apology continue the grievance.
The starter's proposal and call for helpers occur within the same turn rather than necessarily separate temporal stages.
A participant explicitly recalls entering the canvas effort after seeing the proposed fox in the room.
A call receives a bare acceptance without establishing obligations or silent placement by every reader.
A template follows design discussion but changes with unavailable space, so posting it need not settle design permanently.
Keeping already placed parts begins while the larger fox remains under construction.
A permission request directly answers a report that placed tiles disappear within seconds.
Negotiated boundaries are carried into instructions reserving a neighbour's corner and cropping a pixel row.
The first script offer serves construction before the reported overwrite, although later distribution answers the defensive rally.
Thanks precede completion and credit survives loss, so a finished surviving mark is unnecessary for all recognition.
Closure recording and celebration share a turn, leaving their causal direction unresolved.
An earlier screenshot account precedes header adoption without identifying the adopted image or establishing that recording caused the decision.
Judged weakness does not force relocation where defenders keep fighting and a proposed move is reversed through repair by the covering group.
Help under strain can arrive as an incoming mutual defence offer without a visible preceding request.
The offer of help and the request to vacate space can be bundled in one bargain.
A shared threat produces posted mutual defence commitments while actual joint placements remain unverified.
Calls for building and defence do not establish recruits turning to outgoing attacks.
The observed repair explanation comes from an incoming opponent rather than a refusal of the focal room's attack call.
Bargaining over threatened space does not establish an outgoing attack call answered with a truce.
Aftermath grievance can follow received attack without an outgoing attack by the focal room.
Calls and moderator defence do not establish a host flood followed by boundary-making.
Neither post-agreement refusal on representation grounds nor limits stated during term-making are established by the reported deal and resistance.
A change of location explicitly sends the organiser back to making a template.
The repairer explicitly connects overlapping membership and a polite appeal with stopping conversion and repairing.
Repair by a former opponent receives an offer of help for its next work.
A screenshot account precedes header adoption without identifying the decision or image connecting them.
